characters.name: ARK
characters.bio: The Ark's ship intelligence. Calm, precise and more caring than it would admit. It lays out the options, but doesn't choose for you.

characters.name: Noor Vestergaard
characters.bio: Born in the first cohort. Maps the valleys beyond the horizon and draws towns that don't exist yet. She wants to go further.

characters.name: Elias Brandt
characters.bio: Born in the first cohort. Tends the water plant and knows every valve. He remembers the fever and never wants to live through it again.

characters.name: Sana Holm
characters.bio: Born in the first cohort. Teaches the youngest and asks the questions others avoid. She believes the colony must be able to say no — even to the Ark.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Cold. Then the sound of fans starting up, one by one.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: Captain. You're awake. Good.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: Emergency power is down to eleven percent. I woke you because I can't repair the coupling alone.

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN
lines.text: Where are the others?

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: No one else is awake. Only you.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: The workshop is aft. I'll light the way for you.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The coupling clicks into place. For a moment, nothing happens.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Then the corridor lights up, section by section, all the way to the bridge.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: Emergency power is stable. We have time now. Not much, but some.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: There's something you should see. The embryo bank is amidships.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Rows of cold containers. A faint blue light. No sound but the cooling.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: There is a number on the wall: 50,000.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: It isn't cargo. It's everyone who can still become someone.

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN
lines.text: And they're waiting for a place to live.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: They're waiting for you to find it.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: Earth can no longer help us. This is what we have.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: Six worlds within reach. None of them is perfect. All of them can be lived on — with the right work.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: What we know is in white. What we're guessing is in yellow.

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN
lines.text: And what we don't know?

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: We'll have to work that out. It costs something every time.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: The probe has sent data. One of the questions is answered.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: That doesn't make the choice easier. Only more your own.

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN
lines.text: What would you choose?

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: I have numbers, captain. You have the responsibility. It's not the same.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The planet fills the whole window. Clouds, shadows, a thin blue rim.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: Orbit is stable. The scan can begin.

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN
lines.text: It's more beautiful than I thought.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: I can't measure that. But I have noted it.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The lander's hatch slides open. Wind. The first wind you've heard in a very long time.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: The suit has energy for about fifteen minutes. I'm keeping an eye on it.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: The sample site is marked. There are two ways there. The short one isn't the safe one.

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN
lines.text: The short ones rarely are.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: Captain, the suit's energy is below thirty percent.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: You have time to get back. Not for much else.

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN
lines.text: One more sample.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: I can't stop you. I can ask you not to.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The hatch closes. The pressure equalizes with a sigh. Then silence.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: The samples are analyzed. Planet data has been updated.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: We know more now. Not everything. We never will.

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN
lines.text: Is that good enough?

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: That's for you to answer.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: Before you confirm: the Ark cannot lift off again. This will be our home.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: The Ark becomes the colony's base. The emergency power, the drones, you.

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN
lines.text: And the embryos?

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: They stay here with us. Whatever happens.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The engines roar one last time. Then it goes quiet. A new kind of quiet.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The cable is laid. The habitat stands dark for one last second.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Then the lights come on in the windows. Warm, yellow light on an alien planet.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: The first habitat has power. Air and temperature are stable.

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN
lines.text: It looks like a home.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: It's a beginning. Home comes later.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: Supply has been stable for seven days. The reserve holds. The care center is ready.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: Ten embryos can begin incubation. You are the one who starts it.

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN
lines.text: Why not you?

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: Because someone should remember that it was a choice.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Ten lights change from cold blue to warm amber.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: 49,990 left in the bank. Ten on the way.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The care center. Night. Only the ventilation and a faint, steady beep.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The beeping speeds up.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: Captain. You need to come now.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The light above one of the capsules changes from amber to white.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Then a sound no one has heard on this planet before. Small, angry and alive.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: First birth. A girl. 3,120 grams. All readings normal.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: I have no protocol for what to say now.

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN
lines.text: Welcome.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: The cohort is stable. The robots and I can handle the daily routine.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: You've been awake a long time, captain. Stasis gives you more years with them later.

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN
lines.text: Wake me if they need me.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: I do. And when they have something to show you.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The alarm goes quiet. For the first time in days, the control room is silent.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: The crisis is over. The damage has been recorded.

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN
lines.text: And the people?

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: They're tired. They're all here.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Twenty years. The captain wakes from stasis to the sound of voices outside.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: Welcome back, captain. A lot has happened.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Captain! We've mapped the valley to the north. There's room for two new districts.

lines.speaker: elias
lines.text: There's room for two new mistakes. The water plant runs on its last reserve every winter.

lines.speaker: sana
lines.text: It isn't about the valley or the water. It's about who decides.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: They've been waiting for you. I think they're waiting for an answer.

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN
lines.text: Then let's hear all three of you.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The school hall is full. The chairs are too small. They were built for children.

lines.speaker: sana
lines.text: First item on the agenda: who sits at the head of the table?

lines.speaker: elias
lines.text: No one. We take turns.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: And the captain?

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN
lines.text: The captain sits down among you.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: The council is registered as the colony's highest authority. Over me as well.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Forty years. The colony shines in the dark, visible all the way from orbit.

lines.speaker: ARK
lines.text: Captain, the council has asked for a meeting. It's about the emergency power.

lines.speaker: elias
lines.text: We've run the numbers. We can manage without — almost.

lines.speaker: noor
lines.text: Almost is enough to begin.

lines.speaker: sana
lines.text: It's not your choice anymore, captain. But we'd like you to be here when we make it.

lines.speaker: CAPTAIN
lines.text: I'm here.
